name: SwiftUI design system and components
description: A reusable SwiftUI theme and accessible component kit, included by default in planned apps and driven by the plan's design direction and palette.
statusNote: Built into a minimal app with Xcode 27.0 (27A266a) on 2026-10-09.
usage: Use the plan-configured AppTheme spacing, radii, font design and motion duration. Compose feature screens from AppCard, HeroHeader, AppStatTile, AppIconTile, AppChip, AppSectionHeader, AppProgressRing, AppEmptyStateView, AppErrorStateView, SkeletonBlock and ThumbnailPlaceholder; use AppPrimaryButtonStyle for primary actions. Read semantic colors from AppColor. Respect Reduce Motion and Dynamic Type. Choose the layout recipe matching each screen's kind; reserve List/Form for settings and data-entry forms.
